## Invitations

A total of 696 people were invited to the Hill Counties outreach activity. Attendance was 193, representing an attendance rate of 27.7 per cent. The figures indicate that participation was below the number of invitations issued. Outreach arrangements included van days, which were maintained where road conditions allowed. This approach supported access while recognising local travel constraints.

The invitation and attendance figures are recorded for review of the activity and to inform future outreach planning. No further attendance details are recorded in this report.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded as 0. Reminder contacts were also recorded as 0. Accordingly, no SMS messages or reminders were used as part of the recorded contact activity.

The report was prepared by G. Evans. Contacts and attendance are presented separately to distinguish the number invited, the number attending, and the follow-up activity recorded after invitations were issued.
